controls.name: stop-on-empty-page
controls.why: __next__ treats an empty page as the end of the read (the pre-255 shape the unit test test_an_empty_middle_page_does_not_end_the_read guards): the read stops early

controls.name: close-after-exhaustion
controls.why: the cursor calls Close after the server's done page although the server already freed the handle (a second free; an extra round trip)
controls.find: C { closed: page_ends_read(r), srv_open: c.srv_open && !r.done, buf: c.buf + r.rows, ..c }
controls.replace: C { closed: page_ends_read(r), srv_open: c.srv_open && !r.done, buf: c.buf + r.rows, closes: if r.done { c.closes + 1 } else { c.closes }, ..c }

controls.name: server-keeps-handle-at-done
controls.why: the server does not free the handle on the done page (Page :187-188 removed): the handle outlives the read
controls.find: C { closed: page_ends_read(r), srv_open: c.srv_open && !r.done, buf: c.buf + r.rows, ..c }
controls.replace: C { closed: page_ends_read(r), srv_open: c.srv_open, buf: c.buf + r.rows, ..c }

controls.name: skip-close-on-failure
controls.why: a failed Next raises without calling close() (temporal_window.py:108-110): the handle stays open

controls.name: close-not-idempotent
controls.why: close() does not check `closed` (temporal_window.py:118-119): a second close, or a close after the end, sends Close again

controls.name: empty-list-sends-no-key
controls.why: window_spec drops an empty sources list (`if sources:` instead of `is not None`): the server then reads every source

controls.name: server-empty-list-reads-all
controls.why: the server reads an empty list as no filter (mode 0 instead of mode 2)

controls.name: server-empty-page-not-done
controls.why: Page answers an empty page without done when the walk has run out
controls.find: if remaining < k { (remaining, true) } else { (k, false) }
controls.replace: if remaining < k && remaining > 0 { (remaining, true) } else if remaining == 0 { (0nat, false) } else { (k, false) }
